figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Heterologous expression of the MaPKS17 BGC. A) The genomic locus of MaPKS17 BGC, in M. anisopliae, is represented. The MaPKS17 BGC is composed of two 
genes: the backbone (Ba17a) and a hypothetical gene (Ba17b). B) LC-DAD chromatograms of A. nidulans cultures expressing different biosynthetic genes. C) UV–vis 
spectra of 1 (PBA), 2 (BAA) and 3 (BAB). The structure of the compounds is presented in D.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Minimum Inhibitory Concentration assays. The assays were conducted with C. albicans (A, B, and C), C. neoformans (D, E, and F), and S. cerevisiae (G, H, and 
I) to evaluate potential antifungal activities of BAA (A, D, and G) and BAB (B, E, and H). Fluconazole was employed as a positive control for antifungal activity (C, F, 
and I). The assays were conducted in triplicates on two independent occasions. Bars represent the average values from assays, which were evaluated by ANOVA 
followed by posthoc Tukey’s test. The letters above bars indicate the statistical difference between treatments. The error bars represent the standard deviation.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Fluconazole mitigating effect assay. Given the growth-promoting ac­
tivity exhibit by BAA over C. albicans, an assay was conducted to explore if this 
compound could alleviate the fluconazole effects over this fungus. C. albicans 
was grown employing a fixed concentration of BAA (100 mg/L) and variable 
concentrations of fluconazole (0.125 – 64 mg/L). The assay was conducted in 
triplicates. Each dot represents the average values from assays, which were 
evaluated by ANOVA followed by posthoc Tukey’s test. *** p < 0.001; **** p <
0.0001. The error bars represent the standard deviation.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Phylogeny of cAT domains extracted from backbone enzymes. Phylogenetic analysis was performed employing Maximum-likelihood, based on the cAT 
domains predicted in backbone genes exhibited by several fungal species. Orthologs close-related to Ba17a were zoomed, and the structure of some compounds is 
displayed linked to the characterized or suggested backbone enzymes. Branch support values (aLRT SH-like supports) are associated with nodes. A second version of 
this phylogenetic tree is presented in Additional File 7.
